Title: Going Gray Way Earlier Than Your Friends? 3 Habits That Speed It Up

Description:
Gray hair isn't only about genetics - some everyday habits may speed it up. Low vitamin B12 (common on a plant-based diet), overdoing zinc supplements, and chronic stress can all play a role in premature graying, according to research.

Watch to see why each one matters and what may help.
